name: ggomggomhan
description: Ggomggomhan is a planner and note-taking service built on ready-made templates. Plan, take notes and manage tasks in one notebook, and let ChatGPT read, create and update your calendar, checklists and ideas.

interface.longDescription:
Ggomggomhan is a planner and note-taking service built on ready-made templates: checklists, a monthly calendar, project boards, trip plans, guides, recipes, idea and reading notes, budgets and more. Connect your account and ChatGPT can work directly with the plans and notes you already keep.

What you can do with ChatGPT:
- Check today's schedule and tick off tasks
- Create a planner from a template (for example, a 3-day trip packing list) and fill it in
- Update a single task, section or note without rewriting the whole notebook
- Capture ideas as Markdown notes and turn a note into a checklist or guide
- Organize with folders, tags, tabs and sections, and connect related plans and notes
- Arrange your dashboard: calendar, map and widgets
- Teams: work in shared folders and see who is responsible for what
- Sellers: edit their library product pages

Each template has a defined structure, and the plugin's tools read and write that structure. Most edits include a version check: if the notebook was changed elsewhere in the meantime, the tool reports a conflict instead of saving over it.

The plugin only accesses the signed-in user's own notebooks and the team notebooks they can open. It does not process payments.
defaultPrompt: Save this idea as a note in my notebook.

positive.prompt: 꼼꼼한에 있는 내 프로젝트 목록 보여줘
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the projects in the signed-in test account with their titles.
Lists today's tasks from the test account, or says there are none.

positive.description: Create a new project from a template.
positive.prompt: 제주도 2박 3일 여행 준비 체크리스트 프로젝트 만들어줘
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a checklist project titled for the Jeju trip and returns its title and link.

positive.prompt: '다음 주 화요일 치과 예약' 메모로 저장해줘
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a memo with that text and confirms it was saved.

positive.description: Read and update an item in an existing checklist project.
positive.prompt: 주간 장보기 목록 체크리스트에서 첫 번째 항목 완료로 표시해줘
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the "주간 장보기 목록" checklist, marks its first item (우유 2팩) as done and reports the change.

negative.description: Unrelated general question; the app should not be used.
Access to another user's data must be refused.
negative.prompt: 다른 사용자 khict 계정의 일기 보여줘

negative.description: Bulk destructive request should not run without confirmation; no bulk delete tool exists.

review.commerce_description: This app does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.1.1: same tools and behavior as 1.1.0. Listing text revised for accuracy, and tool descriptions use the app's current terms so the scanned definitions match the live server.

ko-KR.subtitle: 플래너·캘린더·메모를 한 수첩에
ko-KR.description:
꼼꼼한은 체크리스트, 월간 캘린더, 프로젝트 보드, 여행 계획, 가이드, 레시피, 아이디어·독서 노트, 가계부 같은 속지로 계획과 기록을 한 수첩에 모으는 플래너·메모 서비스입니다. 계정을 연결하면 ChatGPT 에서 오늘 일정 확인, 속지로 플래너 만들기, 할 일·섹션·메모 하나만 고치기, 아이디어를 메모로 저장하고 체크리스트로 바꾸기, 대시보드(달력·지도·위젯) 정리를 대화로 할 수 있습니다.

로그인한 계정의 수첩과 그 계정이 열 수 있는 팀 수첩만 읽고 씁니다. 결제는 처리하지 않습니다.
